TRIP07OF 07

Five temples · Five elements

Pancha Bhoota Lingas Package

See temples & trip details
  • Earth (Prithvi) — Ekambareswarar Temple, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu; a sand lingam
  • Water (Jala) — Jambukeshwarar Temple, Thiruvanaikaval, Trichy, Tamil Nadu; a spring beneath the lingam
  • Fire (Agni) — Arunachaleswarar Temple, Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu; Shiva worshipped as fire
  • Air (Vayu) — Sri Kalahasteeswara Temple, Srikalahasti, Andhra Pradesh; associated with the flickering sanctum lamp
  • Space (Akasha) — Thillai Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu; the Chidambara Rahasya and Lord Nataraja

AI-created hillscapes · a camera-motion film, not location footage.

A few details

This website keeps your trip preferences in this browser session. Enquiries open a WhatsApp draft that you review and send yourself. No booking, payment or server-side enquiry storage is performed here.

The hero is newly generated Tirumala-inspired landscape artwork, not a documentary photograph. Mountain landscapes are AI-created artwork. Films use camera motion and transitions from those stills. Fonts: Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans, served locally under their open font licences. Hero Dot Field, Momentum Rail and Split Nav adapted from the user-supplied MIT components by Dorian Baffier / Kokonut UI. The rail retains the supplied momentum and spring physics, with original pilgrimage content and styling.

Image credits & artwork

Mountain collection: 30 AI-generated landscapes inspired by Tirumala and the Eastern Ghats, not location photographs or geographic reconstructions. The three films are camera-motion edits made from those still images; the scroll sequences are frames extracted from those films. Vehicle photos were provided by the site owner and are representative models, not confirmation of fleet availability; supplied originals are retained in the source and background-removed, optimized versions show the full vehicles. Tirumala: Vimalkalyan, public domain. Vellore: Ag1707, CC BY-SA 3.0. Padmavathi: Vedamurthy.j, CC BY-SA 3.0. Srikalahasti: Iamvrt46, CC BY-SA 4.0. Srirangam: IM3847, CC BY-SA 4.0. Temple photos resized and converted to WebP; adapted files retain their respective licenses. Somnath: Kuldeep S, CC BY-SA 4.0. Resized and converted to WebP; the adapted photo retains CC BY-SA 4.0.
